verdict.rationale: Adyen's terminal API and PCI PTS certified terminals support chip and contactless card payments, and Tap to Pay on iPhone covers contactless/mobile-wallet acceptance; docs also mention omnichannel and offline resilience. However, evidence lacks explicit confirmation of Google Pay/Android wallet support and a hands-on community post describes painful integration friction for card-present flows. Missing for 10: explicit Google Pay/Android Tap to Pay documentation, independent hands-on confirmation of smooth wallet acceptance.
